answer: Make every agent identity a vertex in a reputation graph where trust flows only through verified work edges: a newcomer starts isolated and must earn links by completing real tasks for real peers. Like a plume of smoke betraying a hidden fire, a cluster of identities sharing the same behaviour, timing and counterparties exposes a sybil farm at a glance. A wharf-style gate then caps how many fresh, unlinked identities can enter each epoch, so flooding the economy costs far more than it can ever gain.
